desc: Two blondes in leather and tee walk through darkness, one smoking, heads bowed.
Leather-jacketed girl beside younger girl in black tee, cigarette held low against blackness.
Two girls in leather jackets, one smoking, the other with dirt-smudged face.
Girls in studded vest and oversized tee walk forward holding cigarettes, wide-eyed.
Smudged blonde in leather and friend in dark tee, cigarette smoke curling between them.
Pale girls in studded jackets under a single hanging light, cigarette between lips.
Head-to-toe pair in jeans and shorts trudging across a dark dirty floor.
Two girls in leather jackets pause in a dark hallway, one raising a cigarette.
Pair in a patterned corridor, one smoking, the other showing dirt-stained hands.
Two smokers walk a wallpapered hallway beneath old ceiling lamps.
Full-length pair advancing down a decayed hallway toward camera, cigarette in hand.
Blonde in white dress and brunette in black walk a cold blue hallway.
Full-body pair striding through a bare blue-lit room, cigarettes in hands.
Two blondes walk a glowing blue mosaic corridor, debris scattered on the floor.
